reviews.title: Limited search option for saved recipes
reviews.text: There is no longer an option to search for a specific recipe in your saved recipe box.  You have to scroll through the entire file to hunt for it. And the pictures are so big that only two recipes show up on the screen so there’s a whole lot more scrolling needed for searching.  What a waste of time

reviews.title: They charged $ for it and it got worse
reviews.text:
I used to love this app. I saved over 100 recipes. Then they started to charge for its use. Ok, I get that. But after I paid for my subscription all of my saved recipes disappeared! Their customer service and support were of no help. Then I was blocked from the app and went through two emails, four different customer service reps on the phone at Epicurious and Conde Naste who couldn’t even find my account! I am done. I canceled subscription. Corporate mismanagement and incompetence ruined a great app again. Congratulations.
Updated 11/9/26: Epicurious became BA and my subscription doesn’t expire until 11/24. Yet they denied my access to the “new” app. Same app, new name, same bad service. Customer service is difficult to reach. Goodbye.

reviews.title: Switched from EPI… pay again!
reviews.text: This is the kind of thing that drives me nuts. They switch from my favorite app, Epicurious to BA. I already had an account with Epicurious, and I pay it for the year. and they’re trying to charge me again for the year when I’ve already paid. Very disappointed.

reviews.title: Inferior Redesign
reviews.text:
Took a great Epicurious app, and made it sub-par.  First, the automatic migration failed to recognize my paid account in the new app. Customer support couldn’t help. Delete and reload didn’t help. After a half a day of support chat and calls was finally able to restore access.

And once in the app, a recipe app, for… cooking food, they brilliantly removed the ability to copy the ingredient list. Want to easily send someone a list of what to pick up dinner prep tonight - tough luck, BA wants to keep you locked into their walled app, even though you pay for the privilege.

reviews.title: Horrible Waste of Money
reviews.text: Been a decades long time subscriber to Bon Appetit, Gourmet and Epicurious. Unfortunately their paid app is garbage. Saved recipes are missing, print function unavailable, no search function or organizing method for saved recipes, and finally customer service is useless.

reviews.title: Bring back saved recipe search function.
reviews.text: The new version of the app looks great, but it’s very frustrating that I can no longer search my saved recipes. I’ve been a subscriber for 10+ years, and have probably saved hundreds of recipes. Now it’s impossible to find anything in that list.

reviews.title: Cannot print? Renders the app obsolete
reviews.text: Not everyone wants their device on their counter while cooking. If you lock all recipes and prevent the ability to print for use in the kitchen, you’re making this enormously user unfriendly.

reviews.title: Irritating “update”
reviews.text: Trading BA for Epicurious seems like fraud. Gourmet recipes are missing and deleted from saved recipes. Intelligent comments are gone (great tips and variations). This is a significant downgrade akin to finding your favorite ingredient suddenly in a far smaller container but costing just as much. I paid for a subscription to Epicurious and have been flipped to this cheap alternative. I HATE IT>

reviews.title: Ugh - Epicurious app was better
reviews.text: Epicurious app has been replaced by Bon appetite- search function is terrible. Recipes that don’t match search. Can’t search on saved recipes

reviews.title: Saved recipe list gone
reviews.text: Had lots of great recipes saved before the transition from Epicurious to BA. Now my saved recipe list is empty.

reviews.title: New app
reviews.text: The app has changed from Epicurious.  I am not able to search my saved recipes.  I have over 1000 saved recipes but no way to find a particular one??  All existing recipe reviews have disappeared?  Will these issues be changed?

reviews.title: Not an improvement
reviews.text: This app is not an improvement over the Epicurious app.  Can no longer search within saved recipes.  So if you have over 200 saved recipes, you have to scroll through them. An improvement from the old Epicurious app would have been to be able to create files for your recipes not take away.

reviews.title: Where’s Epicurious
reviews.text: Epicurious mysteriously became BA. Open the app and search doesn’t work. Where are my saved recipes? So far I can’t tell if it’s a good app because it doesn’t work.

reviews.title: Not working
reviews.text: Can’t get the new app to work I have had for a while now I can’t get it to it. It’s all messed up

reviews.title: Paid for subscription under Epicurious but Condenast ignored it with this change. Need to pay again.
reviews.text: This is another headache caused by a big corporation. I’m not paying again. I have 7 months left on my subscription.

reviews.title: Cannot print recipes
reviews.text: I’d like to be able to print my recipes instead of dropping food and liquids over my iPad during prep.

reviews.title: Update won’t honor my subscription
reviews.text: I paid for the yearly Epicurious subscription on September 7, 2026 and when the app updated it says my subscription is inactive requiring me to pay again in order to access the app and my save recipes

reviews.title: Poor update from Epicurious
reviews.text: The user interface is worse after the update from Epicurious to BA, and the color of the app icon is god awful.

reviews.title: Disconnected and difficult to use
reviews.text: I’m used to using the NYT cooking app and its design is so much easier to use. I love bob Appétit recipes but recipes from bon appetit that come to my inbox via the newsletter never open in the Epicurious app so I can save it, I have to go to the app and search the recipe. And sometimes recipes aren’t even there! The fix is so simple and I would use it so much more if they could make it feel more connected and easy to use and save recipes.

reviews.title: App Stopped Working
reviews.text: Epicurious has been great for a long time and now the app stopped working completely. Signed out and back in, even deleted the app and reinstalled. Still doesn’t work. Their help page says they can only be contacted through the widget on their webpage, but no widget appears. Please fix this issue!

reviews.title: Not free. Bait and switch
reviews.text: Its free to create an account but to see any recipe you must pay. Lol. Terrible business practice

reviews.title: Buggy + awful interface
reviews.text: App never wants to open. Always have to delete and reinstall and most of the time even that won’t work. When it does work, the interface is awful. No ability to search saved recipes so just have to scroll and scroll until you find what you’re looking for. God awful user experience

reviews.title: Subscription required
reviews.text: Just the download is free, everything else needs a subscription. Nothing wrong with that, but say that in the description rather than bait and switch

reviews.title: The app doesn’t seem to want to open anymore
reviews.text: I love this app and have loads of recipes stored in it, but lately it refuses to open. I have tried deleting and reinstalling it but it still won’t.

reviews.title: Love the recipes, not the app
reviews.text: For the life of me, I can’t get this app to load. I’ve deleted and reinstalled the app, restarted my phone and tried every troubleshooting option I could think of and nothing works. The web option works great but the app is like a really really bad soufflé

reviews.title: Recipe Good, function not
reviews.text: This app is good because it has recipes from some of the best cooking magazines. This app is also good because it has really good user reviews of each recipe so you can learn modifications. This app is bad because you can’t store by food type and meal and you can’t sort by most reviewed  just most stars which could be   5 stars with 1 user or 500 users you can’t sort it that way

reviews.title: Paid Subscription, But the App Doesn’t Work at All
reviews.text: Despite having an all-digital access Condé Nast subscription, I’m completely unable to use the app. It gets stuck during startup and never loads any content. I’ve already contacted customer service four times, and the issue still hasn’t been resolved. This has been a really frustrating and disappointing experience.

reviews.title: Used to be Great
reviews.text: This app isn’t as good as it used to be, which is a shame

reviews.title: Paywall
reviews.text: The fact that you can’t even look at a recipe without paying for a subscription is beyond pathetic. One free week is a total joke imo. Everything is put behind a paywall so they can make money off anyone. If they had, say, 50 free spots of recipes to save, I wouldn’t be so irritated.

reviews.title: lost saved recipes
reviews.text: very disappointed with this app.   Search is cumbersome and doesn’t use search criteria specified - get a lot of unrelated “results.”  Big disappointment that recipes are missing from my saved favorites.  Not sure it is worth the money.

reviews.title: Lacking in function
reviews.text: Great recipes but clearly no investment has been made in the apps functionality. Epicurious should take a good look at the NYT food app.

reviews.title: Slooooooooooooow to open
reviews.text: I think the all I fine overall. But, search and the time it takes to just open are so annoying, I just use the website.

reviews.title: Pointless…
reviews.text: After you download the app, you can’t see any of the actual recipes unless you buy a subscription.  I immediately deleted it.

reviews.title: Hard to cancel, not worth the cost
reviews.text:
Can’t cancel on the app, you need to log in to the website. Clicking through is a little tricky, and for a year there the credentials on the app wouldn’t work on the website.

I also asked them to delete my payment info as I had thought I cancelled my subscription last year. The rep I was chatting with said “no can do” and ended the chat.

Additionally; for the cost of an Epicurious subscription you can instead get both an Apple News and New York Times subscription, both of which offer a lot more along with as many recipes as Epicurious.

100% rip off, I would only recommend this app to people I don’t like.

reviews.title: So annoying
reviews.text:
Every time I switch to another app for 5 minutes and come back to this one, it takes me back to the home screen, so I have to click back to the recipe I was following.
And sometimes it just spins.
